name: forgo
description: Language support for forgo (.fgo): syntax highlighting for ?, //forgo:comptime, and //forgo:macro, plus optional gopls-backed language features.

forgo.languageServerPath.description: Path to the gopls binary used for forgo language features (diagnostics are limited on forgo-specific syntax like ?, //forgo:comptime, //forgo:macro).

forgo.enableLanguageServer.description: Start a language server for .fgo files. Disable to use syntax highlighting only.
